attributes.board_name: North Dakota State Board of Pharmacy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs from ACPE-recognized providers; postgraduate courses from a board-recognized school or college of pharmacy (1 CEU = 10 hours); all may be home study
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not required for the first renewal.
rules.carryover: No carryover, except hours earned in the 12 months before a reporting period may count in either period (not both).
rules.alternatives: Board may grant a waiver; such pharmacists cannot practice until reinstated after 15 hours in the prior year.
rules.audit_note: Keep own records 2 years; proof on board request. Missing hours may mean suspension of 30 days or until completed.
rules.notes: Annual reporting period March 1-end of February; renewal fee due on or before March 1. $100 is the in-state active fee (out-of-state $35). Board site nodakpharmacy.com timed out; data from statute and admin code.
rules.legal_basis: N.D. Cent. Code §43-15-25.1; N.D. Admin. Code ch. 61-03-04
